Ava (AE): Heads-up: MediCore Health just escalated to their execs. CISO emailed a tight list: SOC2 Type II report, pen-test summary, and a filled security questionnaire by EOD Mon. CTO also asked for a timeline and cost delta for a Private VPC + reserved Dedicated GPUs vs hosted API. Can we triage and give a one-page for their CTO?
Raj (SE): Quick clarifying question — when they say "Private VPC" do they mean Redwood Private with VPC peering + Reserved Dedicated pool, or a fully air-gapped on-prem option?
Dr. Chen (Customer CISO): We need Redwood Private (VPC peering) with customer-managed keys, routing controls, and a data deletion SLA of <48h for inference logs. On-prem not required. Also need confirmation on whether model weights are ever stored in customer region.
Ben (SRE): We can do VPC peering + reserved Dedicated. Capacity provisioning for a 4x-A100-equivalent pool is ~10 business days if we fast-track, standard is 14-21 days. KMS BYO is supported; need IAM roles + key policy.
Marta (Sales Ops): Pricing note: committed 12mo vs on-demand hosted delta depends on utilization. I'll run two scenarios: low utilization (50% avg) and high (90%) and provide list price vs discounted. Any initial guidance on discount appetite?
Ava (AE): MediCore requested up to 20% off for a 1yr commitment. We can stretch to 15% from AE approval band; anything above requires director signoff.
Lisa (Legal): For the contracts: custom DPA + Private Deployment addendum required for KMS BYO and deletion SLA. I can draft redlines but I need the exact SLA numbers. Also confirm they need SOC2 Type II report (we can provide) and pen-test summary (we have a redacted executive summary).
Raj (SE): Engineering blockers: networking contacts from MediCore for peering (who at their netops), KMS key ARN and admin IAM, and a staging hostname to validate TLS. Once we have those, network validation + routing tests typically 24-72h.
Ben (SRE): On deletion SLA: default is 30d for full logs, but we can offer 48h for inference logs with an ops runbook and extra monitoring — delivery +7 business days. 24h would require additional logging pipeline changes, estimate +14 days and a small ops fee.
Ava (AE): Dr. Chen: would 48h be acceptable as a compromise?
Dr. Chen (Customer CISO): 48h is acceptable for now if contractually guaranteed and logs are encrypted with customer keys. We also require a proof-of-delete procedure.
Marta (Sales Ops): I'll model price with 15% discount as baseline and a second scenario at 20% pending director approval. Also including a one-time onboarding professional services fee for KMS + peering support.
Lisa (Legal): I'll prepare a minimal addendum template: DPA snippet + KMS BYO clause + deletion SLA guarantee. ETA EOD. Ava, please ensure the filled security questionnaire is uploaded.
Ava (AE): Uploaded the MediCore SQ here: https://files.redwood/medi-core-sq-apr2025.pdf and attached SOC2 executive summary.
Raj (SE): I'll produce a short network diagram and VPC peering config snippet. Example snippet for their firewall (they asked):
```
# example VPC peering route table
resource "aws_route" "peer_to_redwood" {
  route_table_id = "rtb-012345"
  destination_cidr_block = "10.200.0.0/16"
  vpc_peering_connection_id = "pcx-0abcd1234"
}
```
Will deliver artifacts in ~5 hours.
Ben (SRE): I'll DM the KMS policy template and a proof-of-delete playbook (redacted). Snippet: ```{"Statement": [{"Sid": "AllowRedwood", "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::redwood:role/infra"}}]}``` ETA 4h.
Marta (Sales Ops): Action: I'll present pricing delta + PS fee + approval path in 3 hours. If finance needs to escalate I'll ping @director-sales.
Lisa (Legal): Action: draft DPA + Private Addendum and mark the clause for 48h deletion + KMS BYO. I'll flag any unusual risks.
Ava (AE): Please give me single-line blockers with owners I can bring to MediCore CTO during the 10am sync tomorrow.
Raj (SE): Raj: Need MediCore netops contact + staging TLS FQDN (blocker).
Ben (SRE): Ben: Need IAM/KMS admin role and permission to validate key policy (blocker).
Marta (Sales Ops): Marta: Need commitment term and target discount band to present price options (blocker).
Lisa (Legal): Lisa: Need confirmed deletion SLA numeric (48h) + SQ answers to finalize addendum (blocker).
Ava (AE): Thanks team. I'll push for netops contact and confirm deletion SLA with Dr. Chen. If anything changes, @here. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy for VPC peering templates scheduled 02:30 UTC tomorrow (no customer impact).
